text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a newborn, I will be asking your caregiver questions about your symptoms and medical history. To start, what is your age in days, and what specific symptoms have brought you in today?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis (Suspected)

Based on the mother's lack of prenatal care and missing immunization records, this newborn is at high risk for congenital infections. I need to confirm this suspicion with specific testing.

REQUEST TEST: VDRL (on newborn's serum), Rapid Plasma Reagin (RPR), and Dark-field microscopy if lesions are present.
REQUEST TEST: Quantitative Treponema pallidum antibody test (TP-PA or FTA-ABS).
